cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the instructions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I unlock the hall at nine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Submit your preferred concert time to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't put me on the committee. I only send the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've voted to invite the whole street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How lovely. I'll send them to the six people I have addresses for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give you the full address list tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Just mark which six you'd most like me to find stamps for.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send a sad face.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tonight? We have two chairs.

cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.
